unsupported.why: the paper analyses only the naive first box (p. 17); everything after the first box's belief questions is omitted (meta.omitted)

keyed.why: N=3/MPCR=0.4 inputs fall from 9 to 4 over 16 rounds (computers 4.7 vs humans 3.0 printed; n.s. effects are not sign-checked); difficult boxes stay near 10 in short games and fall to ~6 by round 40 in long games; beliefs lower after long games (4 vs 9); everyone answers 'Yes'
